SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(IF(status = #{pendingConfirm}, 1, 0)) AS waitConfirmCount, SUM(IF(status = #{pendingAudit}, 1, 0)) AS waitAuditCount, SUM(IF(status = #{checkedIn}, 1, 0)) AS finishedCount, SUM(IF(status = #{checkedIn}, 1, 0)) AS totalCount, ROUND(SUM(IF(status = #{checkedIn}, 1, 0)) / COUNT(1), 2) AS progress FROM check_in WHERE deleted = 0
AND YEAR(confirm_time) = #{year}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalRegisterCount, COUNT(confirm_time) AS totalConfirmCount, ROUND(COUNT(confirm_time) / COUNT(1), 2) AS checkinRate, COUNT(account_create_time) AS accountCreatedCount, ROUND( COUNT(account_create_time) / COUNT(1), 2) AS accountCreateRate FROM check_in WHERE deleted = 0
AND YEAR(confirm_time) = #{year}
